data.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?

result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For most small online stores, **Stripe is the best all-around payment processor**, but if you're using Shopify, I'd recommend **Shopify Payments** instead.

The best choice depends on your e-commerce platform, where your customers are located, and how much you're processing each month.

Since you're in Canada, I'd compare these five options\:

## Best payment processors for a small Canadian store

![Stripe Conversion Tracking – Able Customer Data Platform](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/uLblf37t9qmSgXH90IIrfyM1cEVlAyfeKTR0KIuJzNcMC_B2ZUJW9p7BftOV-yzXikVmn2jDYU_Zq1ExkRO0GTjHIMaYqcU4RzMNo1YrpDxk3GXGSNzey-FFdr644M2DVq4UsY3Zo9OE1wDfp2BQqWf9beRf_8lKhubJp-AjxGHf8Zwil7Ew0fyQc0BJ2PlA?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- No monthly processing fee.
- Easy integration with WooCommerce, Wix and custom websites.
- Supports subscriptions and international payments.
- Great reporting and fraud prevention.

**Best for\:** Independent online stores.

[Stripe Canada](https://stripe.com/ca)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Built directly into Shopify.
- No separate payment gateway setup.
- Integrated refunds, reporting and checkout.
- Avoids Shopify's additional third-party transaction fee.

**Best for\:** Stores already running on Shopify.

[Shopify Payments Canada](https://www.shopify.com/ca/payments)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal**

- Familiar and trusted by online shoppers.
- Supports PayPal wallet payments and card checkout.
- Easy to add to most online stores.

**Best for\:** An additional checkout option to give customers flexibility.

[PayPal Business Canada](https://www.paypal.com/ca/business)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Square**

- Online and in-person payments.
- POS hardware and inventory tools.
- Straightforward setup.

**Best for\:** Businesses selling online and at markets, events or retail locations.

[Square Canada](https://squareup.com/ca/en)

---

![Top five fintech news stories of the week: 28 August 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Nvwm5m0AvFIyEQCoAUiuiBYsES5Z_TGIIL3a7sg7Vv4eL9Itvfc5xa-EyPsr8IsSKHecG5NYexO0SMIejzwZMML07_ctHuEIL4ButxRVQGAmBUqOEkJLjZgpEozhbgzBigkUW3PNM8qwMbcubKNhZeml3Fh_1lYV5P7aYAnQGGfgg1x4XdQzyp-dffUe_NGw?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Helcim**

- Canadian payment processor.
- Interchange-plus pricing.
- No standard monthly subscription.
- Worth comparing as transaction volume grows.

**Best for\:** Businesses processing enough payments to benefit from customized processing economics.

[Helcim](https://www.helcim.com/)

## Canadian processing fees at a glance

| Processor | Standard online card fee |
|--------|--------|
| Stripe | 2.9% + \$0.30 CAD |
| Shopify Payments Basic | 2.8% + \$0.30 CAD |
| Shopify Payments Grow | 2.6% + \$0.30 CAD |
| Shopify Payments Advanced | 2.4% + \$0.30 CAD |


These are published standard rates; international cards, currency conversion and other payment types can cost more. [stripe.com](https://stripe.com/en-ca/pricing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.shopify.com](https://www.shopify.com/ca/pricing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

If I were starting a small Canadian online store\:

- **Shopify store\:** Shopify Payments + PayPal.
- **WooCommerce store\:** Stripe + PayPal.
- **Custom website\:** Stripe.
- **Online and physical retail\:** Square.
- **Growing sales volume\:** Compare Helcim's interchange-plus pricing.

I wouldn't start with an expensive monthly merchant account unless your sales volume justified it.

## Three questions to narrow it down

I can recommend the best option based on your actual business rather than just general rankings.

**1\. What platform is your store using?**
